# Build: molly-gap-axhub-cors

## Brett said (verbatim)
At: 2026-11-10T22:09:27.000Z
> Standalone apps keep working until Molly covers them; list gaps as pending builds.

## What to build
Continue build "Molly gap: axHub allows Molly's origin on /auth/api/* (CORS with credentials) so native screens read the hub session" (molly-gap-axhub-cors) — Phase 1, model Opus.
What Brett asked for (build-origin@1, his words come first; a paraphrase never replaces them):
Brett said (2026-11-10 22:09):
"Standalone apps keep working until Molly covers them; list gaps as pending builds."
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 10 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.
Checkpoints: Steps are checkpoints inside this ONE session, not separate tasks: work through them in order without stopping between them; when a step is finished, commit it on your branch, push, then tick it done before starting the next. Nothing is lost if the session dies: the next session picks up at the first open step on the same branch. Never ask for a new prompt or a relaunch per step.
Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens.
API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached.
Branch: claude/molly-gap-axhub-cors
Steps in this phase (1 left, ~20 min):
[x] s1 (~30 min) Found by molly-sign-in-once s1. From https://molly.amberxai.com, GET https://axhub.amberxai.com/auth/api/session answers 200 with no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, and the preflight OPTIONS /auth/api/logout answers 200 with no CORS headers, so a browser on Molly cannot read the hub session or post a write. The hub should answer an allow-list of amberxai.com app origins (Molly first) on /auth/api/* with Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoing the origin, Access-Control-Allow-Credentials true, Access-Control-Allow-Headers content-type, accept, x-axhub-csrf, Vary Origin; never * with credentials. The session cookie is same-site (SameSite=Lax is enough). Molly side is in place: apps/molly/src/molly/credentials.ts (axhub provider, credentials include, X-AxHub-CSRF on writes).
[x] s2 (~30 min) Standalone apps keep working until Molly covers them; list gaps as pending builds.
[ ] s3 (~20 min) Tests green, report _claude/builds/reports/molly-gap-axhub-cors.md, THREADS row, commit, push, PR
Read first: _claude/builds/reports/molly-gap-axhub-cors.md, _claude/THREADS.md
Tick each step right after its commit: node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs act step molly-gap-axhub-cors <stepId> done — it reaches main at once (builds-live). Link your branch / PR: node framework/cli/builds-live.mjs link molly-gap-axhub-cors --branch <b> --pr <n>.
Watch live: when you start on a screen, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "…"` so the live preview follows you.
Screenshots that are not for approval (checking a screen, live captures, before/after): axf shot <file> --name "…" --app … --screen … --group "<build name>" (UI Review → Screenshots; ui-review-item@1), never the review queue.

## Pipeline
This session was started by the orchestrator's dispatcher on Claude account mossesx-max- for the Opus phase. Work through every step of the phase in this one session: they are checkpoints, not separate tasks. As each step finishes, commit it on your branch, push, and tick it (orchestrator.mjs act step molly-gap-axhub-cors <stepId> done), then go straight on to the next; nothing is lost if the session dies, the next one starts at the first open step on the same branch. When this phase's steps are done, stop: the dispatcher starts the next phase on the right account. If you must stop early with steps left, say why in a build note (orchestrator.mjs act note molly-gap-axhub-cors "…"); the build goes back to Pending for Brett.
